Enquiry ka tareeka

Bas chaar step

Online order nahi hai — gehna dekh kar, pehen kar liya jata hai. Enquiry sirf baat shuru karne ke liye hai.

01

Design chuno

Upar collections me jo pasand aaye, usi category ko neeche enquiry me chuno — naam yaad rakhna kaafi hai.

02

Message taiyaar karo

Naam aur occasion bharo — ready-made enquiry message ban jayega. Copy karke store ko bhejna hai.

03

Rate aur purity confirm karo

Aaj ka gold rate, purity / hallmark aur making — ye teen cheezein final price se pehle store se saaf poochho.

04

Store par aakar dekho

Gehna haath me lekar, pehen kar dekho. Pasand aaye tabhi lo — yahi 1933 se chalta aaya tareeka hai.
